part1_desc: 第 1–24 步：跟站长学 just、already、yet，分清完成时和过去时。
part2_desc: 第 25–42 步：独立看第二周记录，最后是 6 道挑战题——没有提示，还混了以前学的被动语态和最高级。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：just/already/yet、现在完成时与一般过去时的区别、for/since。Unit 5 Educational exchanges 主题。

steps.title: 交换生第一周
steps.teach_html:
【承上启下】前两天学了现在完成时。今天看教育交流的故事，找里面的完成时句子。

交换生来了一周了。站长说：这期咱们聊聊他们第一周都干了啥。

小林说：“我刚参观完学校。”安娜说：“我已经交到新朋友了。”汤姆说：“我还没吃过饺子。”

“刚刚”“已经”“还没”，英文里有三个小词：just、already、yet。

steps.title: just：刚刚
steps.teach_html:
just 表示“刚刚”，放在 have/has 和过去分词之间：

I have just arrived.（我刚到。）

记住位置：have + just + 过去分词。

steps.title: already：已经
steps.teach_html:
already 表示“已经”，用在肯定句里，位置和 just 一样：

She has already finished.（她已经做完了。）

记住：have + already + 过去分词。

steps.title: yet：还没
steps.teach_html:
yet 用在否定句末尾，表示“还没”：

I haven't finished yet.（我还没做完。）

记住：haven't + 过去分词 + yet，yet 放最后。

steps.title: yet：已经（疑问）
steps.teach_html:
yet 用在疑问句末尾，表示“已经……了吗”：

Have you finished yet?（你做完了吗？）

对比：否定句 yet = 还没；疑问句 yet = 已经了吗。看句子来定。

steps.title: 完成时 vs 过去时
steps.teach_html:
注意区分：现在完成时说经历，不说具体时间；一般过去时说具体过去时间的事。

I have been to Beijing.（我去过北京——经历）

I went to Beijing last year.（我去年去了北京——具体时间）

steps.title: 时间标志词
steps.teach_html:
看到这些词，用现在完成时：already、yet、just、ever、never。

看到这些词，用一般过去时：yesterday、last week、in 2020（具体过去时间）。

比如：I went there yesterday.（昨天去的，用过去时。）

steps.title: for 和 since
steps.teach_html:
说“持续多久”，用 for + 一段时间：for two years（两年了）。

说“从何时起”，用 since + 过去时间点：since 2020（从2020年起）。

I have learned English for three years. / since 2021.

steps.title: 小结
steps.teach_html:
小结：just/already 放 have 后面；yet 放否定句末（还没）或疑问句末（了吗）；有具体过去时间用过去时。

下面站长带着你练。资料卡在上面，做题时对照着看。

steps.title: 先看资料
steps.teach_html:
这是第一周记录。做题时对照着看：李明—刚到学校—已经认识安娜；安娜—已参观图书馆—还没吃饺子；汤姆—昨天去了公园。

下面练 just/already/yet。
steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 刚到
steps.stem: Li Ming has ______ arrived at school.
steps.explain: Li Ming has just arrived at school.

wrong_feedback.A: already 是“已经”，这里“刚刚”用 just。
wrong_feedback.B: yet 放句末，这里用 just。
wrong_feedback.D: ever 是“曾经”，这里用 just。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 已经认识
steps.explain: Li Ming has already met Anna.

wrong_feedback.B: yet 一般不放肯定句中间，这里用 already。
wrong_feedback.C: just 是“刚刚”，这里“已经”用 already。
wrong_feedback.D: never 是“从来没有”，和“已经认识了”意思正好反了；肯定句说“已经”用 already。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 还没吃
steps.help: 否定句末尾“还没”用什么？
steps.explain: Anna hasn't eaten dumplings yet.

wrong_feedback.A: already 不放否定句末，这里用 yet。
wrong_feedback.B: just 放 have 后面，这里句末用 yet。
wrong_feedback.C: ever 是“曾经”，这里用 yet。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 参观完了吗
steps.scene: 问她参观完图书馆了吗。
steps.help: 疑问句末尾“了吗”用什么？
steps.explain: Has she visited the library yet?

wrong_feedback.A: already 不放疑问句末，这里用 yet。
wrong_feedback.C: just 放 have 后面，这里句末用 yet。
wrong_feedback.D: never 是“从来没有”，不能放进这个问句里；问“参观完了吗”，句末要用 yet。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 昨天去了
steps.explain: Tom went to the park yesterday.

wrong_feedback.A: yesterday 是具体过去时间，用过去时 went，不用完成时。
wrong_feedback.B: 同上，用过去时；而且主语是 Tom，不用 have。
wrong_feedback.D: goes 是一般现在时，说的是平常的事；昨天已经发生完的事要用过去时 went。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 去过
steps.scene: 他去过北京。（无具体时间）
steps.help: 说经历，不说具体时间，用什么？
steps.explain: He has been to Beijing.

wrong_feedback.A: goes 是一般现在时，说的是平常的事；这里说“去过北京”这种经历，要用现在完成时 has been。
wrong_feedback.B: went 是过去时，这里说经历用完成时。
wrong_feedback.C: going 是现在分词，前面得先有 be 动词才能用；这里 been 的前面缺的是 has：He has been to Beijing。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 三年了
steps.stem: He has learned English ______ three years.
steps.explain: He has learned English for three years.

wrong_feedback.B: since 后面跟过去时间点，这里“三年”是段时间，用 for。
wrong_feedback.C: in 接一段时间时表示“过多久之后”，不表示“持续了多久”；“持续三年”要用 for。
wrong_feedback.D: at 用来指钟点（比如 at 7 点），不能接“三年”这样的时间段；表示持续用 for。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 从2020年起
steps.explain: He has lived here since 2020.

wrong_feedback.A: for 后面跟一段时间，这里 2020 是时间点，用 since。
wrong_feedback.C: from 只指出从哪儿开始，不表示一直持续到现在；现在完成时里“从 2020 年起”要用 since。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 刚吃完
steps.explain: I have just eaten lunch.

wrong_feedback.A: already 是“已经”，这里“刚刚”用 just。
wrong_feedback.B: yet 放句末，这里用 just。
wrong_feedback.D: ever 是“曾经”，这里用 just。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 写出过去分词：finish
steps.scene: 把 finish 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 finish 的过去分词。
steps.explain: finish → finished。

common_errors.say: finishing 是现在分词，过去分词是 finished。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: just 还是 yet
steps.explain: I haven't finished yet.

common_errors.say: already 不放否定句末，用 yet。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: just 还是 already
steps.explain: I have already finished.

common_errors.say: yet 不放肯定句中间，用 already。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 写出过去分词：write
steps.scene: 把 write 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 write 的过去分词。
steps.explain: write → written。

common_errors.say: wrote 是过去式，过去分词是 written。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 过去时
steps.explain: He went to Shanghai yesterday.

common_errors.say: yesterday 是具体过去时间，用过去时 went。

steps.reading: Week 1: Li Ming has just arrived at school, has already met Anna; Anna has already visited the library, hasn't eaten dumplings yet; Tom went to the park yesterday

steps.title: 新任务：独立判断
steps.teach_html:
新任务：这是第二周的记录——小梅、杰克、莉莉。

资料在上面。这次你自己看、自己答，站长不提示了。

记住：just/already 放 have 后面；yet 放否定句末或疑问句末；具体过去时间用过去时。
steps.reading: Week 2: Mei has just joined the club, has already made friends; Jack hasn't tried noodles yet, went to the museum last Sunday; Lily has danced for two years, since 2023

steps.title: 刚加入
steps.explain: Mei has just joined the club.

wrong_feedback.A: already 是“已经”，强调早就做完了；这里小梅是“刚刚”加入俱乐部，要用 just。
wrong_feedback.C: yet 只能放在否定句或疑问句的句末，不能放在 has 后面；这里说“刚刚”，用 just。
wrong_feedback.D: ever 是“曾经”，一般在疑问句里问经历；这里是陈述“刚刚加入”，用 just。

steps.reading: Week 2: Mei has just joined the club, has already made friends; Jack hasn't tried noodles yet, went to the museum last Sunday; Lily has danced for two years, since 2023

steps.title: 已经交朋友
steps.explain: Mei has already made friends.

wrong_feedback.A: yet 要放在句末，而且多用在否定句和疑问句里；这里是肯定句说“已经”，要用 already。
wrong_feedback.B: just 是“刚刚”，强调动作刚发生那一刻；这里说的是“已经交到朋友了”这个结果，用 already。
wrong_feedback.C: never 是“从来没有”，意思正好反了：小梅已经交到朋友了，要用 already。

steps.reading: Week 2: Mei has just joined the club, has already made friends; Jack hasn't tried noodles yet, went to the museum last Sunday; Lily has danced for two years, since 2023

steps.title: 还没尝
steps.explain: Jack hasn't tried noodles yet.

wrong_feedback.B: already 用在肯定句、放在 has 后面；这里是否定句句末说“还没”，要用 yet。
wrong_feedback.C: just 放在 has 后面表示“刚刚”；这里空在句末、又是否定句，要用 yet。
wrong_feedback.D: ever 是“曾经”，多用在疑问句里；这里是否定句说“还没尝过”，句末用 yet。

steps.reading: Week 2: Mei has just joined the club, has already made friends; Jack hasn't tried noodles yet, went to the museum last Sunday; Lily has danced for two years, since 2023

steps.title: 上周日去了
steps.scene: 杰克上周日去了博物馆。
steps.stem: Jack ______ to the museum last Sunday.
steps.explain: Jack went to the museum last Sunday.

wrong_feedback.A: last Sunday 是具体的过去时间，要用一般过去时；现在完成时（has gone）不能和具体过去时间一起用，所以选 went。
wrong_feedback.B: have gone 错了两处：last Sunday 要用过去时；而且主语 Jack 是一个人，也该用 has 不是 have。这里直接用 went。
wrong_feedback.D: goes 是一般现在时，说的是平常的习惯；这里讲的是上周日已经发生的事，用过去时 went。

steps.reading: Week 2: Mei has just joined the club, has already made friends; Jack hasn't tried noodles yet, went to the museum last Sunday; Lily has danced for two years, since 2023

steps.title: 跳了两年
steps.explain: Lily has danced for two years.

wrong_feedback.A: since 后面跟的是一个时间点（比如 2023 年）；two years 是一段时间，前面要用 for。
wrong_feedback.C: in 接一段时间时是“在……之后”的意思，不表示“持续了多久”；“持续两年”要用 for two years。
wrong_feedback.D: at 用来指钟点（比如 at 7 点），后面不能接“两年”这样的时间段；表示持续用 for。

steps.reading: Week 2: Mei has just joined the club, has already made friends; Jack hasn't tried noodles yet, went to the museum last Sunday; Lily has danced for two years, since 2023

steps.title: 从2023年起
steps.explain: Lily has danced since 2023.

wrong_feedback.A: for 后面跟一段时间（比如 two years）；2023 是一个时间点，“从那时起一直到现在”要用 since。
wrong_feedback.B: from 只说从哪儿起，不表示一直持续到现在；现在完成时里“从某年起”固定搭配是 since。
wrong_feedback.C: in 2023 是“在 2023 年”，说的是那一年里发生的事；这里是“从 2023 年一直到现在”，用 since。

steps.reading: Week 2: Mei has just joined the club, has already made friends; Jack hasn't tried noodles yet, went to the museum last Sunday; Lily has danced for two years, since 2023

steps.title: 写出过去分词：speak
steps.scene: 把 speak 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 speak 的过去分词。
steps.explain: speak → spoken。

common_errors.say: spoke 是过去式，过去分词是 spoken。

steps.reading: Week 2: Mei has just joined the club, has already made friends; Jack hasn't tried noodles yet, went to the museum last Sunday; Lily has danced for two years, since 2023

steps.title: yet 还是 already
steps.explain: Have you finished yet?
steps.reading: Week 2: Mei has just joined the club, has already made friends; Jack hasn't tried noodles yet, went to the museum last Sunday; Lily has danced for two years, since 2023

steps.title: 写出过去分词：break
steps.scene: 把 break 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 break 的过去分词。
steps.explain: break → broken。

common_errors.say: break 不规则，过去分词是 broken。

steps.reading: Week 2: Mei has just joined the club, has already made friends; Jack hasn't tried noodles yet, went to the museum last Sunday; Lily has danced for two years, since 2023

steps.title: 过去时
steps.explain: She went to Beijing last week.

common_errors.say: last week 用过去时 went。

steps.reading: Week 2: Mei has just joined the club, has already made friends; Jack hasn't tried noodles yet, went to the museum last Sunday; Lily has danced for two years, since 2023

steps.title: 挑战 · 去过香港吗
steps.stem: ______ your sister ever been to Hong Kong?
steps.help: 先数一数：主语是一个，还是多个。
steps.explain: Has your sister ever been to Hong Kong?

wrong_feedback.A: 主语 your sister 是一个（第三人称单数），现在完成时的疑问句要用 Has 开头，不用 Have。
wrong_feedback.C: Is 后面不能直接跟 been 组成完成时；问“去过没有”要用 Has 开头：Has ... ever been。
wrong_feedback.D: Does 后面要跟动词原形，跟不了 been；表示经历的疑问句要用 Has。

steps.title: 挑战 · 得过奖吗
steps.stem: ______ your brother ever won a prize?
steps.help: 先数一数：主语是一个，还是多个。
steps.explain: Has your brother ever won a prize?

common_errors.say: 主语 your brother 是一人（第三人称单数），句首要用 Has，不用 Have。

steps.title: 挑战 · 新路
steps.scene: 这条新路是去年修好的。
steps.help: 先想：路是自己修的，还是被人修的？再看时间是去年还是现在。
steps.explain: The new road was built last year.

wrong_feedback.A: builds 是主动语态“（人）修”，可路是被人修的，要用被动语态。
wrong_feedback.B: built 是主动语态的过去式，意思是“（谁）修了”；路是被修好的，要用被动 was built。
wrong_feedback.C: is building 是“正在修”，而且是主动；这里说的是去年已经修好了，用过去的被动 was built。

steps.title: 挑战 · 英语被广泛使用
steps.scene: 英语在很多国家被使用。
steps.task: 写出空里的两个词（be 动词 + 过去分词）。
steps.help: 先想：英语是自己用的，还是被人使用的。
steps.explain: English is spoken in many countries.

common_errors.say: speaks 是主动“（人）说”；英语是被说的，要用被动 is spoken。
被动语态要用过去分词：speak 的过去分词是 spoken，写 is spoken。

steps.title: 挑战 · 最高的山
steps.scene: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山。
steps.stem: Mount Qomolangma is the ______ mountain in the world.
steps.help: 看范围：是跟一个比，还是跟全世界比。
steps.explain: Mount Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world.

wrong_feedback.A: higher 是比较级，只用来比两者高低；这里和全世界比，要用最高级 highest。
wrong_feedback.B: high 是原形，the 后面表示“最……”时要用最高级 highest。
wrong_feedback.D: 比较级、最高级前面不能再加 more；“最高的”是 the highest。

steps.title: 挑战 · 刚到机场
steps.stem: They ______ just arrived at the airport.
steps.help: 先数一数：主语是一个，还是多个。
steps.explain: They have just arrived at the airport.

wrong_feedback.B: has 只跟第三人称单数（he、she、it）走；主语 They 是复数，要用 have。
wrong_feedback.C: is 后面不能直接跟 arrived 组成完成时；“刚到”要用 have arrived。
wrong_feedback.D: was 是过去的 be 动词，跟不了 arrived 表完成；“刚到、和现在有关”要用现在完成时 have arrived。

steps.title: 节目预告
steps.teach_html:
第二周的记录看完了，最后的挑战题也闯过来了——里面混着的被动语态和最高级，你都碰到了。

下一期，站长教你写交流日记——用现在完成时写下自己的经历。

title: 刚做完：just、already、yet
